priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility for overseeing financing transactions to the Finance Committee. Everson's resignation was submitted in a letter, which is attached to the filing as an exhibit, and he did not serve on any committee of the Board at the time of his resignation. The company believes Everson was granted full access to its books and records, except for materials related to pending litigation involving Toby Neugebauer, whom Everson represented on the Board.

general.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh holds a press conference after officials kept interest rates unchanged. He says inflation is still too high and policy makers will "deliver price stability." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Bank of Canada Rate Hike Hurts Housing Market Already in Slump
general.summary: The Bank of Canada raised its benchmark interest rate Wednesday in an effort to fight inflation. But for the nation’s housing market, the move is a heavy blow.

general.title: Apple brings touch to the Mac, reversing years-old stance on touchscreen laptop
general.summary: Apple announces a new touchscreen laptop, the company's third major launch under new CEO John Ternus.

general.title: Stellantis stock rises 13% as automaker's turnaround plan, cost cuts gain traction
general.summary: European car giant Stellantis said Wednesday that it recorded a 4 billion euro ($4.5 billion) cash shortfall in the third quarter.

general.title: ServiceNow Falls After Quarterly Sales Outlook Revives AI Fears
general.summary: ServiceNow Inc. shares plunged after the company gave an outlook for quarterly subscription sales that met analysts’ estimates, but failed to quell Wall Street’s anxieties that artificial intelligence will disrupt the software maker.

general.title: Global Bond Sales Shatter Record, Fueled by AI Borrowing Binge
general.summary: Global bond sales have soared to an all-time high, catapulted by breakneck borrowing from the tech juggernauts at the forefront of the AI boom.

general.title: Alphabet Shares Tank on Sales Misses Across Core Businesses
general.summary: Alphabet Inc. posted disappointing sales from most of its core businesses in the third quarter, escalating investors’ concerns about the hundreds of billions of dollars that the company is spending on artificial intelligence. The stock fell in late trading.

general.title: SK Hynix shares jump 11% after record quarterly profit, outperforming broader market
general.summary: Shares of South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix soared 11% on Wednesday as third-quarter profit sharply beats estimates.

general.title: T-Mobile Boosts Profit, Adds Customers on New Rate Plans
general.summary: T-Mobile US Inc. added more total customer accounts in the third quarter than analysts had expected, showing its slate of offers and loyalty incentives are resonating with customers.

general.title: Oracle stock pops 11% as long-term revenue forecast and clarity on financing ease debt concerns
general.summary: Oracle issued a revenue forecast for fiscal year 2030 of $225 billion, and said it will limit additional fundraising over that stretch to $20 billion.

general.title: XRP 'At The Heart' Of Everything Ripple Does: Garlinghouse
general.summary: Brad Garlinghouse, CEO of Ripple, joins Scarlet Fu and Isabelle Lee on "Bloomberg Crypto." From the Ripple Swell Conference, Garlinghouse says the company is leaning into regulation and licensing as it seeks to make its US dollar-backed stablecoin, RLUSD, “the most trusted stablecoin.” He also discusses the utility of Ripple's XRP token and Ripple's recent acquisitions. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Fifteen-Minute Bets Scratch the Bitcoin Itch
general.summary: Bloomberg's Emily Nicolle joins Scarlet Fu and Isabelle Lee on "Bloomberg Crypto." While Bitcoin appears to have fallen into an autumnal slumber, another corner of the speculative trading arena is thriving. Prediction-market volumes are soaring to new heights, and even with token prices rangebound, crypto’s playing its own role in the bounce. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Fed's Warsh 'Sensitive' to AI, BlackRock's Rosenberg Says
general.summary: Jeffrey Rosenberg, senior portfolio manager for the systematic alternatives ETF at BlackRock, reacts to the Federal Reserve's decision to leave interest rates unchanged. Speaking on "Bloomberg Surveillance: The Fed Decides," Rosenberg says the Federal Reserve recognizes that conditions have tightened but stops short of calling them tight, while connecting interest rates to AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.summary: Bloomberg Intelligence's Nathan Dean joins Scarlet Fu and Isabelle Lee on "Bloomberg Crypto." general.title: Burnham Budget Hopes for the Best in Turbulent Times for UK
general.summary: Andy Burnham promised to “bring back hope” when he replaced the unpopular Keir Starmer as Britain’s prime minister in July. His first budget will require a dose of luck, as well.

general.summary: Laide Majiyagbe, global head of markets at BNY, joins Scarlet Fu and Isabelle Lee on "Bloomberg Crypto." She discussed the demand for blockchain enabled improvements from clients. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Fed Will Raise Rates in December, Clarida Predicts
general.summary: Former Federal Reserve Vice Chairman Richard Clarida expects the Fed to raise rates in December and then possibly again in March. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance: The Fed Decides." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Chris Wright Says Diesel Exports From Arabian Gulf Likely to Increase
general.summary: Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that he expects diesel prices to be 'dropped significantly' but will need increased exports out of the Arabian Gulf to manage it amid the ongoing war with Iran. Wright also Russia's diesel output, saying that the only way Russia can benefit from recently permitted exports of diesel is to deliver a ceasefire on energy or end the war. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Fed to Phase In New FOMC Meeting Schedule Starting Next Year, Warsh Says
general.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said the US central bank will likely reduce the number of interest-rate decisions it makes each year to six from eight, and will begin phasing in the new meeting schedule in 2027.

general.title: Oracle Jumps After Projecting Return to Positive Cash Flow
general.summary: Oracle Corp. shares jumped after the company gave a long-term outlook for free cash flow that eased investor nerves about the potential payoff from its artificial intelligence spending.

general.title: Here Are the Key UK Budget Measures Announced by John Healey
general.summary: John Healey’s budget punted the biggest decisions facing Andy Burnham’s new UK government into the future, focusing instead on modest measures designed to help ordinary Britons and businesses weather the cost-of-living crunch..

general.title: Fed Leaves Rates Unchanged, Cook and Hammack Dissent
general.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee voted 10-2 to hold its benchmark federal funds rate in a range of 3.75% to 4%. Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack were the dissenting votes. Bloomberg's Michael McKee reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
